entities.name: Zhulodok
entities.description: An Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage that razed Akoum and whose followers became the first vampires of Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi Titan who tricked cultists into weakening his prison.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who slew Zhulodok and resealed the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: Mountainous region of Zendikar where the escape began.

entities.name: Windblast Gorge
entities.description: Gorge carved out by a night of Zhulodok's feeding.

events.summary: As the Hedron Network weakens, Zhulodok is among the first Eldrazi to awaken at the head of Ulamog's brood.
events.quote: Zhulodok was among the first wave to awaken

events.summary: Zhulodok's feeding carves out Windblast Gorge.
events.quote: a single night of feeding carved out the shape of the Windblast Gorge

events.summary: Cultists who followed Zhulodok's carnage become the first vampires of Zendikar.
events.quote: They became the first vampires of Zendikar.

events.summary: Nahiri slays Zhulodok and reseals the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison.
events.quote: Nahiri slew Zhulodok and sealed the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison again

relations.quote: Zhulodok appeared at the head of Ulamog's brood
